title: What Makes a Strong Model? A Unified Spectral Analysis of Knowledge Transfer
implementation: clean-room; no author implementation was present in the accepted source archive
claims: Unified spectral analysis of SGD transfer dynamics separates geometric mismatch, propagated teacher error, and student optimization error.
Knowledge distillation expands the weaker student's effective spectral horizon and improves high-frequency learning.
Weak-to-strong transfer uses spectral denoising: a student can filter teacher optimization noise in low-intrinsic-dimension tasks.
